name: saveFile
description: Save the active Packet Tracer workspace to an absolute path. Packet Tracer reports save status through an event, not a return value, so always verify afterwards that the file exists on disk. The target directory must already exist.

filePath.description: Absolute Windows path ending in .pkt, forward slashes accepted (e.g. F:/Labs/U1_02_LAB_OSPF_solucion.pkt).
